@graph.description: St. John's wort (Hypericum perforatum) is a flowering herb studied for depressive symptoms, but it is not a low-friction self-care supplement. Hyperforin-rich products can induce drug-metabolizing enzymes and transporters, while serotonergic combinations can be dangerous; product standardization and a pharmacist or prescriber interaction review are central to any benefit-risk decision.
